title: Steerable Pluralistic Policy Alignment from Anonymized Crowd Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.26914v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pluralistic alignment requires AI systems to learn from diverse populations whose preferences may reflect heterogeneous or even conflicting objectives, and to personalize their behavior to individual users. Existing approaches in pluralistic alignment often assume access to annotator identities and rely on powerful pretrained representations to model individual preference variations. We propose Preference-PCA Pluralistic Learning (P3L), a novel framework for pluralistic alignment that jointly learns trajectory embeddings and the shared basis of preference directions via PCA decomposition from heterogeneous crowd feedback without requiring annotator identities. At test time, our approach enables rapid and accurate personalized reward learning and downstream policy optimization. translated_title: 基于匿名群体反馈的可引导多元化策略对齐
translated_abstract: 多元化对齐要求AI系统能够从偏好可能反映异构甚至相互冲突目标的多元人群中学习，并使其行为能够针对个体用户进行个性化。现有的多元化对齐方法通常假设可以获取标注者的身份信息，并依赖强大的预训练表示来建模个体偏好差异。我们提出了偏好PCA多元化学习，这是一种新颖的多元化对齐框架，它通过PCA分解从异构的群体反馈中联合学习轨迹嵌入和偏好方向的共享基，而无需标注者身份信息。在测试时，我们的方法能够实现快速且准确的个性化奖励学习和下游策略优化。在多个具身控制任务上的实验表明，P3L实现了可引导的个性化对齐，其泛化能力超越了离线数据集，可推广至分布外场景。
tldr: 提出P3L框架，无需标注者身份信息，通过PCA分解从匿名群体反馈中联合学习轨迹嵌入与偏好方向共享基，实现可引导、可泛化的个性化策略对齐。
en_tdlr: P3L is a novel pluralistic alignment framework that jointly learns trajectory embeddings and a shared basis of preference directions via PCA decomposition from anonymized crowd feedback, enabling steerable and generalizable personalized policy alignment without requiring annotator identities.
